overview.title: A wild Atlantic headland
overview.p1: Cap Beddouza offers cliffs, sea horizons and a wilder feel than Safi's urban waterfront.
overview.p2: Ideal for photos and light walks. Plan a vehicle or taxi.
overview.p3: Combinable with a morning in town and an afternoon at the cape.
